text: William Luther Pierce's The Turner Diaries was classified as hate literature by Canada Customs, which issued an import prohibition in July 1996. Canada Customs had stopped the book at the border half a dozen times before, and reviewed it once a new edition came out with a mainstream publisher. In April 2006 the book was banned in Germany.
